newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Barito Pacific unit signs $991 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Barito Pacific unit signs $991 mln loan.

text.p: A unit of timber company PT Barito Pacific, PT Tanjung Enim Lestari Pulp and Paper, signed a $991 million loan agreement with 25 foreign banks on Friday for setting up a new pulp mill, company officials said.
Tanjung Enim's president commissioner Prajogo Pangestu, who also heads Barito Pacific, said the loan would be used to finance a new 450,000-tonne-capacity pulp mill in South Sumatra.
"The plant will start operation at the end of 1998 or early 1999," Prajogo told reporters after the signing ceremony.
Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi, Fuji Bank and Sakura Finance were among the banks in the lending consortium, officials said.
